We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, maybe we need to get NMR spectra to infer number of methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum string. Then we can count distinct methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, etc). But we need number of CH3 groups, not signals. Could be overlapping. Might need carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That gives list of carbon shifts. Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm. Count them.

We need to minimize cost. Probably just get carbon NMR and count methyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
